[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Suits by or against minors and persons of unsound mind
 Section: O32R1::Minor to sue by next friend.
]


Every suit by a minor shall be instituted in his name by a person who in such suit shall be called the next friend of the minor.
2[Explanation.—In this Order, “minor” means a person who has not attained his majority within the meaning of section 3 of the Indian Majority Act, 1875 (9 of 1875) where the suit relates to any of the matters mentioned in clauses (a) and (b) of section 2 of that Act or to any other matter.]
